package db

import (
	"database/sql"
	"fmt"
)

type Todo struct {
	ID        int     `db:"id"`
	Title     string  `db:"title"`
	Completed bool    `db:"completed"`
	CreatedAt time.Time `db:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt time.Time `db:"updated_at"`
}

func (t *Todo) Insert(db *sql.DB, title string) error {
	return db.QueryRow(`
	INSERT INTO todos (title, completed)
	VALUES ($1, $2)
	RETURNING id
	`, title, false).Scan(&t.ID)
}

func (t *Todo) Get(db *sql.DB, id int) error {
	return db.Get(t, `
	SELECT id, title, completed, created_at, updated_at
	FROM todos
	WHERE id = $1
	`, id)
}

func (t *Todo) Update(db *sql.DB, id int, title string, completed bool) error {
	return db.QueryRow(`
	UPDATE todos
	SET title = $2, completed = $3, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
	WHERE id = $1
	RETURNING id
	`, id, title, completed).Scan(&t.ID)
}

func (t *Todo) Delete(db *sql.DB, id int) error {
	_, err := db.Exec(`
	DELETE FROM todos
	WHERE id = $1
	`, id)
	return err
}

func ListTodos(db *sql.DB) ([]Todo, error) {
	var todos []Todo
	err := db.Select(&todos, `
	SELECT id, title, completed, created_at, updated_at
	FROM todos
	ORDER BY created_at
	`)
	return todos, err
}

package db

import (
	"database/sql"
	"time"

	"github.com/lib/pq"
)

type Todo struct {
	ID        int       `json:"id"`
	Title     string    `json:"title"`
	Completed bool      `json:"completed"`
	CreatedAt time.Time `json:"created_at"`
	UpdatedAt time.Time `json:"updated_at"`
}

func (t *Todo) Insert(db *sql.DB) error {
	query := `
		INSERT INTO todos (title, completed)
		VALUES ($1, $2)
		RETURNING id, created_at, updated_at
	`
	err := db.QueryRow(query, t.Title, t.Completed).Scan(&t.ID, &t.CreatedAt, &t.UpdatedAt)
	return err
}

func GetTodo(db *sql.DB, id int) (*Todo, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT id, title, completed, created_at, updated_at
		FROM todos
		WHERE id = $1
	`
	var todo Todo
	err := db.QueryRow(query, id).Scan(&todo.ID, &todo.Title, &todo.Completed, &todo.CreatedAt, &todo.UpdatedAt)
	if err == sql.ErrNoRows {
		return nil, nil
	}
	return &todo, err
}

func ListTodos(db *sql.DB) ([]*Todo, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT id, title, completed, created_at, updated_at
		FROM todos
	`
	rows, err := db.Query(query)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer rows.Close()

	var todos []*Todo
	for rows.Next() {
		var todo Todo
		err := rows.Scan(&todo.ID, &todo.Title, &todo.Completed, &todo.CreatedAt, &todo.UpdatedAt)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		todos = append(todos, &todo)
	}

	return todos, nil
}

func UpdateTodo(db *sql.DB, id int, update Todo) (*Todo, error) {
	query := `
		SELECT id, title, completed, created_at, updated_at
		FROM todos
		WHERE id = $1
	`
	var todo Todo
	err := db.QueryRow(query, id).Scan(&todo.ID, &todo.Title, &todo.Completed, &todo.CreatedAt, &todo.UpdatedAt)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	query = `
		UPDATE todos
		SET title = COALESCE($2, title), completed = COALESCE($3, completed)
		WHERE id = $1
		RETURNING id, title, completed, created_at, updated_at
	`
	err = db.QueryRow(query, id, update.Title, update.Completed).Scan(&todo.ID, &todo.Title, &todo.Completed, &todo.CreatedAt, &todo.UpdatedAt)
	return &todo, err
}

func DeleteTodo(db *sql.DB, id int) error {
	query := `
		DELETE FROM todos
		WHERE id = $1
	`
	_, err := db.Exec(query, id)
	return err
}

package main

import (
	"flag"
	"log"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/yourusername/todo-app/db"
	"github.com/yourusername/todo-app/handlers"
)

func main() {
	port := flag.String("port", "8080", "Port to listen on")
	flag.Parse()

	dataSourceName := "user=postgres dbname=todos sslmode=disable"
	d, err := db.NewDB(dataSourceName)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("failed to connect to the database: %v", err)
	}

	h := handlers.NewTodosHandler(d)

	http.HandleFunc("/todos", h.List)
	http.HandleFunc("/todos/", h.Get)
	http.HandleFunc("/todos", h.Create).Methods("POST")
	http.HandleFunc("/todos/", h.Update).Methods("PUT")
	http.HandleFunc("/todos/", h.Delete).Methods("DELETE")

	log.Printf("Listening on :%s", *port)
	if err := http.ListenAndServe(":"+*port, nil); err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("failed to start server: %v", err)
	}
}

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"os"

	"github.com/yourusername/todo-app/db"
	"github.com/yourusername/todo-app/handlers"
	"github.com/gorilla/mux"
)

func main() {
	port := os.Getenv("PORT")
	if port == "" {
		port = "8080"
	}

	dataSourceName := "todos.db"
	database, err := db.OpenDB(dataSourceName)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("failed to open database: %v", err)
	}
	defer database.Close()

	todoHandler := &handlers.TodoHandler{DB: database}

	r := mux.NewRouter()
	r.HandleFunc("/todos", todoHandler.ListTodos).Methods("GET")
	r.HandleFunc("/todos", todoHandler.CreateTodo).Methods("POST")
	r.HandleFunc("/todos/{id}", todoHandler.GetTodo).Methods("GET")
	r.HandleFunc("/todos/{id}", todoHandler.UpdateTodo).Methods("PUT")
	r.HandleFunc("/todos/{id}", todoHandler.DeleteTodo).Methods("DELETE")

	fmt.Printf("Server listening on port %s\n", port)
	log.Fatal(http.ListenAndServe(fmt.Sprintf(":%s", port), r))
}
